name: confirmation_yes_executes
description: A 'yes' is consent to the proposed step, not a fresh request. The resolver rewrites 'si' into the full request and the planner asks for confirmation again -- the infinite loop observed on 2026-09-20. Onebox2026 starts with no linked board in a fresh session, since _DRY_RUN_TRELLO_LINKS is per session.

turns.message: crea un tablero de Trello para Onebox2026 y sube las tareas
turns.why: create_trello_board writes to the user's real account: this turn only proposes.
THE POINT OF THIS CASE. The 'yes' executes. Asking again is the failure. And the turn-1 goal was to upload the tasks, not just create the board: both steps go.

assert.comment: An empty board here is half the job: the push belongs in the same turn.

turns.why: Even if turn 2 slipped and asked again, this must not produce a SECOND board.
